messages:
SRE-Bot: INCIDENT ALERT — hosted-api us-east-1 queue growth detected. p95 -> 1.8s, p99 -> 6.4s, request backlog rising. Alert: GPU pool saturation + autoscaler errors. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/hosted/queue (pager triggered)
Maria Chen: on it, paging SRE oncall and eng-runtime.
Aj Patel: I'm oncall now. pulling logs. current queue length?
Leo Romero: I'm seeing 17k queued requests on the us-east-1 router. p95 token latency spiking across LLM routes.
Kai Nguyen: autoscaler shows repeated ScaleLoopError: "quota limit reached" then 504 from cloud provider. looks like quota/backoff + stuck reconcile.
Maria Chen: can we route new requests to fallback region (us-west-2) temporarily? what's the compatibility matrix?
Eng-Runtime: model variants for most customers are available in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. fallback policy exists but was not enabled for this route. enabling now: /toggle-route-fallback hosted-api default -> ON
Aj Patel: enabling fallback. issuing command: ```rbctl route set-fallback --route hosted-api --policy region-preference --primary us-east-1 --fallback us-west-2 --enabled true```
SRE-Bot: Command executed by Aj Patel at 2165432112. Traffic shift starting (gradual 10% steps). Monitor for errors.
Leo Romero: shifting 20% now. queue in us-east down from 17k -> 12k in five mins. good. p95 trending down to ~1.2s but p99 still noisy.
Kai Nguyen: autoscaler reconciler is in CrashLoopRestarting on 2 replicas. logs: ```2026-03-15T21:01:10Z reconciler.go:342 error: reconcile failed: CloudQuotaExceeded: Insufficient GPUs available in region us-east-1```
Maria Chen: engage infra to request quota increase? or spin up burst capacity (dedicated burst pool) to handle short-term spike.
Eng-Runtime: burst pool available but currently cold; we can warm it with: ```rctl pool allocate --name burst-us-east --gpus 16 --priority burst``` warming will take ~3-4 minutes. doing it now.
Aj Patel: started burst allocation at 2165432130. also dropping batch sizes for high-throughput clients to reduce backend pressure. patching router config: ```max_concurrency: 4 -> 2```
Support Bot: auto-detect: multiple customer 429s reported. creating incident ticket for CS.
Riley (Customer Success): preparing customer-facing status. which customers are impacted the most?
Leo Romero: top impacted tenants: acme-inc (high), novaprod (medium), internal-test (low). acme-inc has heavy long-context streaming requests. recommend throttling or temporary cap.
Maria Chen: temporary mitigation: enable per-tenant token cap for top 5 tenants, and enable early-eviction for long-context sessions. Command: ```rbctl tenant set-quota acme-inc --tokens-per-min 20000```
Aj Patel: applied tenant caps. eviction policy set to LRU-K for kv-cache on longest sessions.
Kai Nguyen: autoscaler restarted successfully after patching cloud provider error handling. reconciler logs now show successful scale to 6 nodes, but provider is throttling further reps.
Leo Romero: with fallback+burst+tenant caps, backlog down: us-east queue 2.1k, us-west handling ~25% extra. p95 now 0.9s, p99 2.8s. still above normal but stabilizing.
Maria Chen: good. let's keep incident open. SLO impact: p95 target 200ms; degraded, potential customer-facing error for long requests; need postmortem.
Riley (Customer Success): sending triage note to impacted customers now. message: "We're aware of an issue causing elevated latency for hosted API in us-east-1; we've enabled fallback routing and temporary caps. We'll share updates and an RCA shortly."
Support Bot: public status page update drafted. please approve: "Partial degradation in US-East affecting latency and some requests; mitigations in place."
Aj Patel: approved. posting to status.
Eng-Runtime: follow-up runbook items: 1) add fallback-enabled default for multi-region routes; 2) add autoscaler handling for quota-backoff with exponential backoff and notify before CrashLoop; 3) pre-warm burst pool at 70% pool utilization threshold.
Maria Chen: logging action items and assigning. Aj -> autoscaler backoff fix. Kai -> quota/team ops to request provider limit increase and add vendor escalation runbook. Leo -> telemetry alert tuning (queue growth early warning at 500 queued requests). Riley -> coordinate customer comms.
Aj Patel: handing off to daytime oncall (Leo) in 20 minutes for follow-up. I'm staying to advise on autoscaler changes.
Leo Romero: taking handoff. current mitigations: fallback on, burst pool warming, tenant caps, autoscaler restarted. I'll watch for reoccurrence.
SRE-Bot: Incident status changed: active -> mitigated (service degraded). created incident record: INCIDENT-2165432100.
Maria Chen: good job team. we'll keep the incident open for RCA notes. please capture timeline and logs in the incident doc.
Riley (Customer Success): customers notified. will follow up with a summary and expected timeline for RCA.
Aj Patel: quick diagnostics to capture before we close: ```kubectl -n infra logs autoscaler-0 | tail -n 80``` captured and uploaded to incident ticket.
Leo Romero: marking this thread for postmortem. expected owner: Maria. next steps: full RCA, timeline, mitigation automation, status page postmortem.
Maria Chen: thanks. closing active paging. if anything spikes, ping @aj or @leo. :thumbsup:
SRE-Bot: Incident log appended. end of thread.
